name: Via Ba at Ba Den
nameVi: Lễ vía Bà Linh Sơn Thánh Mẫu
summary: The pilgrimage of Bà Linh Sơn Thánh Mẫu at Chùa Bà and Điện Bà on Ba Den falls on lunar days 4, 5, and 6 of the fifth month. In 2026 the management program ran 18–20 June, the operator’s side-event page 18–22 June, and a Sun World article 18–21 June. The heritage page puts the bath of the statue at 0:00 on the 4th, doors shut, and calls the 5th the main day. The 2026 program puts the bath at 18:00 on 18 June, with a noon rite each day and a farewell of the monks at 12:30 on 20 June. Both bath hours stay. Recognition is 4 September 2018 on the mountain introduction, and the festival page says the decision was received on 14 August 2019. Both dates stay. The next solar date is check on arrival. The June cable prices are a closed window. A 2027 fare is check on arrival.
when: Lunar 4, 5, and 6 of the fifth month. 2026 windows: 18–20 June, 18–22 June, and 18–21 June. Bath at 0:00 on the 4th, and at 18:00 on 18 June 2026. Later years: check on arrival.
